data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Matthew Buffa, Michael Irwin, and Vanja Videnovic, having raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses total capital raised ($6M) as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $15M valuation. The Peer-Median method draws on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The median across this set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

Triangulating these two approaches yields a median valuation of $208M, with a low-end anchor of $13M and a high-end ceiling of $460M. The wide dispersion—driven primarily by substantial variance in peer valuations—reflects material uncertainty around comparable company selection and stage-appropriate multiples in the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment. Key unknowns include Breaker's specific traction metrics relative to peers, market differentiation, and whether early-stage momentum justifies Defense & Security peer premiums.
